questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT a source of atmospheric carbon?

Which of the following depicts the correct sequence of membranes of the chloroplast,
beginning with the innermost membrane and ending with the outermost membrane?

options.A: Outer membrane, inner membrane, thylakoid membrane
options.B: Thylakoid membrane, inner membrane, outer membrane
options.C: Inner membrane, thylakoid membrane, outer membrane
options.D: Thylakoid membrane, outer membrane, inner membrane

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Thylakoid membrane, inner membrane, outer membrane

questions.stem_text: Which statement about variation is true?

options.A: All phenotypic variation is the result of genotypic variation.
options.B: All genetic variation produces phenotypic variation.
options.C: All nucleotide variability results in neutral variation.
options.D: All new alleles are the result of nucleotide variability.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All new alleles are the result of nucleotide variability.

questions.stem_text:
Most animal cells, regardless of species, are relatively small and about the same size.
Relative to larger cells, why is this?

options.A: Smaller cells are more resilient to external damage.
options.B: Smaller cells have a larger number of organelles.
options.C: Smaller cells require less energy to function.
options.E: Smaller cells fit together more tightly.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Smaller cells are more resilient to external damage.
